skill.summary: Generate click-worthy thumbnails from any video with AI — extract the best frame, enhance faces, add bold text overlays, apply proven thumbnail compositions,...

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Thumbnail Maker — Initial Release

- Launches automated thumbnail creation from any video using AI for best frame extraction and enhancement.
- Supports adding bold text overlays, face enhancement, proven thumbnail compositions, and clean backgrounds.
- Enables A/B testing by generating multiple design variations per video.
- Batch thumbnail generation supports series branding and consistent visual style.
- Provides a clear API with parameters for custom styles, text, colors, and frame selection.
- Returns high-resolution thumbnails with mobile previews for rapid review and selection.
